correctness.rationale: The graphical group is class two in this range, with central commutator generated by the ab independent cross edges and elementary abelian abelianization of order q^(a+b). Class two is less than the odd residue characteristic. Each commutator functional, via a fixed nontrivial field additive character, gives a unique a-by-b matrix M; alternating rank is 2i for rank M=i because the two kernel dimensions are a−i and b−i. The ordinary character-rank formula then gives q^(a+b−2i) times the rank-stratum count, and only degrees q^i. Equivalently the twisted group algebra at a fixed commutator character has center spanned by the radical basis elements; it is free over its center on the radical cosets. Each simple block has dimension q^(2i), giving q^(a+b−2i) characters of degree q^i. Rank-i matrices are products of a full-column-rank a-by-i factor and a full-row-rank i-by-b factor, uniquely up to an invertible change of the i-dimensional intermediate basis. This gives the product, including i=0 by the empty product. At (q,a,b)=(3,2,2), ranks have counts 1,32,48, and the degree-square sum is 81+288·9+48·81=3^8. The finite checker was inspected, not executed; it is corroboration over its sampled prime fields, not a proof over all odd prime powers.
